title: How Does a Health Insurance Program Covering 500 Million Poor Impact Credit Market Outcomes?
eligible_reason: Single adoption date. Treatment is abimp = 1 for every state except the four non-implementing opposition-ruled states (DL, TS, WB, OR; data_cleaning_code.do lines 102-103 and 291-292), interacted with one common post indicator (post = 1 from the 5th quarter of the 8-quarter window, i.e. 2019Q2 onward in the MFI data, lines 127-129; same timing in the KCC data, lines 307-309). int_ay = post*abimp (line 144). All treated districts switch on at the same date, so there is one cohort and Callaway-Sant'Anna/BJS collapse to the two-group DiD. The Figure 1 event study (int_2018_q3 ... int_2020_q1) is likewise a single-cohort quarter-by-treated interaction. Fails the at-least-two-adoption-dates rule.
design_notes: PM-JAY launched September 2018; border-district sample (border==1) comparing implementing vs non-implementing states; district x quarter-year panel of microfinance (MFI) and agricultural (KCC) loan delinquency. Main spec Table 4: reghdfe volume_default_90_plus int_ay abimp post if pre_lend==1 & border==1 & state!=MH,KA, absorb(district qrt_yr ru_classification lendertype) cluster(district); columns add lg_rn (rainfall), lg_nl (night lights), lg_ticket (time-varying controls) and disbursal_period_actual FE. Tables 5-7: state-pair placebos (Punjab vs Haryana/HP, Punjab vs Delhi, Odisha vs WB with PM-Kisan, Telangana Aarogyasri). Table 8: household savings/borrowing (Consumer Pyramids) with district and month/wave FE. Table 3: NFHS first stage (cross-sectional change and two-period DiD). HonestDiD sensitivity (Figure 1).
n_adoption_cohorts_note: One cohort: all implementing states treated from the same quarter (post==1 for qrt_yr_int>=5).
modern_estimators_named: honestdid (Rambachan-Roth sensitivity, not a staggered estimator)
